issues.text: New in round 2. 'The same risk table' assumes I know the review has a risk table; section 5 so far showed only the challenge table, and the fourth-row sentence never says its step comes from a separate risk table.
issues.quote: The same risk table gives the product owner an open question: the bank has not yet confirmed which root and CA.
issues.fix: In the fourth-row sentence, say where the step is written: 'The fourth row is a risk, listed in the review's risk table and owned by the backend developer: …'.

issues.text: New in round 2. After the paraphrase, option c is clearly the longest and the only one with two reasons joined by 'and', so I could pick it by shape alone.
issues.quote: The bank would not accept a root of Đơn Hàng's own, and a clock the signer controls proves nothing once someone else can sign.
issues.fix: Give one distractor (e.g. b) a second clause of similar length, or shorten c to about the length of the others.

issues.text: New in round 2. Option d is about half again as long as a, b and c and is the only one that explains a mechanism, so the length gives it away.
issues.quote: Once Payments holds the key at start, an attacker inside Payments can take a copy that keeps working after the fix; the HSM never lets it out.
issues.fix: Trim d to one clause, e.g. 'A key Payments holds at start can be copied and used after the fix; an HSM never lets it out.'
